sources.title: UK Emissions Trading Scheme for maritime: how to comply
sources.scope: operator identity, voyage and in-port scope, exclusions, monitoring plans, emissions gases, simplified monitoring, reports, allowances and deadlines

sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: Participating in the UK ETS
sources.scope: maritime entry from 1 July 2026, offshore-vessel entry from 1 January 2027 and operator obligations

sources.title: UK ETS scope expansion: domestic maritime - main Authority response
sources.scope: first scheme-year dates, double-surrender treatment, scope decisions, exemptions and transition design

controls.input_condition: A maritime record belongs to the first UK ETS maritime scheme year
controls.expected_action: Use 1 July 2026 through 31 December 2026 as the monitoring period; do not backfill January to June 2026
controls.risk_prevented: Inflating the first-year emissions period

controls.input_condition: A maritime record belongs to scheme year 2027 or later
controls.expected_action: Use 1 January through 31 December as the scheme-year boundary
controls.risk_prevented: Continuing the 2026 half-year convention into later years

controls.input_condition: A ship performs a potentially regulated maritime activity
controls.expected_action: Require gross tonnage of at least 5,000 unless a separate exclusion applies; ships below 5,000 GT remain excluded
controls.risk_prevented: Applying UK ETS maritime obligations to sub-threshold ships

controls.input_condition: A ship moves from a UK port of call to the same or another UK port of call without an intervening non-UK port of call
controls.expected_action: Classify the movement as an in-scope UK ETS voyage and monitor all voyage emissions
controls.risk_prevented: Omitting domestic or same-port return voyages

controls.input_condition: A ship arrives from or departs to a non-UK port but performs berth, hotelling or within-port movements at a UK port of call
controls.expected_action: Exclude the international voyage under current domestic scope but include all qualifying UK in-port emissions
controls.risk_prevented: Discarding UK in-port emissions merely because the connected voyage is international

controls.input_condition: A UK-to-UK movement includes a stop used exclusively for refuelling, operational supplies, qualifying crew relief, dry dock, repairs, weather shelter, medical emergency, search and rescue, or distress assistance
controls.expected_action: Do not treat that stop as a port of call; preserve voyage continuity and include emissions released during the stop where the guidance requires
controls.risk_prevented: Incorrectly splitting or excluding a domestic voyage

controls.input_condition: A qualifying ship is at berth, hotelling, anchored for relevant port activity, or moving between berths within a UK port of call
controls.expected_action: Include all greenhouse-gas emissions from the in-port activity even when no UK-to-UK voyage occurred
controls.risk_prevented: Restricting maritime accounting to propulsion between ports

controls.input_condition: The activity is performed by an offshore ship
controls.expected_action: Treat it as excluded through 31 December 2026 and apply the maritime regime from 1 January 2027 when the remaining criteria are met
controls.risk_prevented: Applying the offshore-vessel start date to the wrong scheme year

controls.input_condition: A ship performs an excluded military, search-and-rescue, firefighting, humanitarian, government-function or other listed excluded activity
controls.expected_action: Exclude the activity and its qualifying ancillary positioning voyages and related in-port activities
controls.risk_prevented: Charging emissions that the statutory scope expressly excludes

controls.input_condition: An ISM company rather than the registered owner is proposed as the maritime operator
controls.expected_action: Require responsibility for ship operation, ISM Code compliance and UK ETS compliance under a legally binding written agreement
controls.risk_prevented: Assigning obligations to an ISM company that lacks the complete legal delegation

controls.input_condition: A registered owner delegates UK ETS responsibility to an ISM company
controls.expected_action: Start the delegation no earlier than the date the legally binding agreement is completed; do not backdate responsibility
controls.risk_prevented: Reallocating historical emissions to an entity that was not yet legally responsible

controls.input_condition: A delegation agreement is terminated or materially changed
controls.expected_action: Notify the regulator and vary the relevant monitoring-plan section within 14 days
controls.risk_prevented: Leaving operator responsibility stale after a legal change

controls.input_condition: A maritime operator starts its first UK ETS maritime activity
controls.expected_action: Apply at operator level for an emissions monitoring plan in METS within 42 days
controls.risk_prevented: Operating without a timely approved monitoring framework

controls.input_condition: The operator has UK ETS responsibility for a ship that is missing from its submitted fleet list
controls.expected_action: Continue to account for that ship's in-scope emissions and separately correct the monitoring plan
controls.risk_prevented: Using an administrative omission to suppress emissions

controls.input_condition: An in-scope maritime activity produces greenhouse-gas emissions
controls.expected_action: Monitor and report CO2, methane and nitrous oxide and express the result as CO2 equivalent
controls.risk_prevented: Reporting CO2 alone and understating maritime emissions

controls.input_condition: An operator proposes annual rather than per-voyage fuel monitoring for a ship
controls.expected_action: Allow simplified monitoring only when more than 300 voyages are scheduled in the same scheme year, the operator is responsible for them and the ship performs only voyages and in-port activities
controls.risk_prevented: Using simplified monitoring for an ineligible operating pattern

controls.input_condition: A maritime scheme year has ended
controls.expected_action: Submit the independently verified annual emissions report through METS by 31 March of the following year
controls.risk_prevented: Promoting unverified or late maritime emissions as compliant

controls.input_condition: The surrender obligation relates to maritime scheme year 2026 or 2027
controls.expected_action: Use 23:59 UK time on 30 April 2028 as the surrender deadline for both years
controls.risk_prevented: Incorrectly demanding 2026 surrender in April 2027 or splitting the transitional deadline

controls.input_condition: Emissions arise from a voyage between a Northern Ireland port of call and a Great Britain port of call
controls.expected_action: Monitor and report 100% of emissions but deduct 50% when calculating the emissions figure for surrender
controls.risk_prevented: Applying the deduction to monitoring or omitting the parity adjustment

controls.input_condition: The verified maritime emissions figure and any applicable surrender deduction are known
controls.expected_action: Surrender one UK allowance for each tonne of CO2 equivalent in the net emissions figure for surrender
controls.risk_prevented: Confusing gross reported emissions with the net allowance obligation
